result.rationale: The validation regex in app/models/embeddable_host.rb explicitly allows an optional port: /\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i. However record_for_host uses `uri.host`, which in Ruby excludes the port (URI('http://example.com:8080').host == 'example.com'). A host saved as 'example.com:8080' (the before_validation only strips scheme and path, not port) is stored with the port, but lookup does `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` with host='example.com', so it can never match the stored 'example.com:8080' row. Thus a port-bearing host passes validation but silently
